$comment: /labs/ — Find a Lab, with Start a Lab beside it (/labs/start/), and the words for each Lab's own page (/labs/<id>/). The Labs come from content/labs; a city still gathering names never shows a count this low, it says to be the first. No one owns a Lab (home-copy.md).

meta.need: As someone who wants to take part near where I live, I need to know whether there's a Lab near me, and what to do if there isn't, so that I can join one or start one.

title: Find a Lab
description: Each city has its own Lab, run by the people in it and at home in its public library. DC is up and running, and more cities are gathering names.

hero.title: It starts in your city.
hero.lede: Each city has its own Lab, run by the people in it and at home in its public library. DC is up and running, and more cities are gathering names.

list.title: The next cities.
list.lede: Every Lab starts as a list of names. When a city's list is long enough, and someone there wants to lead, it opens.
list.first: Be the first on the list

stages.$comment: Each Lab's stage, said plainly, on the list and on the Lab's page.

elsewhere.title: Not on the list?
elsewhere.body: Join, and tell us where you are. Your name starts the list for your city.

start.title: The next Lab could start with you.
start.body: Every Lab starts with a few people who want one where they live. You don't need to have done this before.

lab.$comment: Words for a Lab's own page.
lab.comingEmpty: Nothing is on the calendar right now. Join, and you'll hear the moment the next one is.

join.title: Come along.
join.lede: Make your free account, and you'll see what's on here.

listJoin.title: Put your name down.
listJoin.lede: Enough names, and it opens. You'll hear the moment it does.
listJoin.note: It takes a free account: sign in with Google, and your name goes on the list.

startPage.$comment: /labs/start/ — Start a Lab: the requirements up front and one first step (TEDx, Toastmasters: see the project doc information-architecture).

meta.need: As someone who'd start a Lab where I live, I need to know what it takes, what I bring and what The Labs brings, so that I can take the first step.

startPage.title: Start a Lab
startPage.description: Every Lab starts with a few people who want one where they live. You bring the people. We'll bring the workshops, the Build Cycle and the tools, and help you find it a home at your public library.

hero.title: The next Lab could start with you.
hero.lede: Every Lab starts with a few people who want one where they live. You don't need to have done this before.

bring.title: You bring the people. We bring the rest.

you.title: You bring
items: A few people who want a Lab where they live
Somewhere to meet, or the will to find one
An evening a week, to start

we.title: We bring
items: The workshops, and the people who've run them
The Build Cycle, and help running the first one
The platform every Lab runs on
Help finding a home at your public library

stages.title: Five stages, at your pace.

items.title: Gathering names
items.body: People in your city put their names down. Yours can be the first.

items.title: Forming
items.body: Someone steps up to lead, and a library or a space comes into view.

items.title: First workshops
items.body: A few sessions, with workshops and help from the cities that came before.

items.title: First Build Cycle
items.body: Twelve weeks, Pods and teams, and a Showcase of your own.

items.title: Chartered
items.body: A Lab in its own right, part of the network, run by the people in it.

stages.early: The first people in a city decide what its Lab becomes.

join.title: Start with your name.
join.lede: Make your free account and tell us where you are. We'll talk it through with you.
